steps.en: Download the quantized 2B build (1.56 GB) from the official GGUF repo
steps.zh: 从官方 GGUF 仓库下载 2B 的量化版（1.56GB）

steps.en: Serve it with stock llama.cpp — no custom kernels or model-code fork
steps.zh: 用原版 llama.cpp 起服务，不需要自定义算子或改模型代码

steps.en: Loads as a standard Llama-architecture model on your CPU or laptop GPU
steps.zh: 以标准 Llama 架构加载，跑在你的 CPU 或笔记本显卡上

steps.en: Send chat requests with the recommended sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, min_p 0)
steps.zh: 按推荐采样参数发对话请求（min_p 要设成 0）

steps.en: Answers with step-by-step thinking and XML-style tool calls, all on the device
steps.zh: 带分步思考作答、按 XML 格式发出工具调用，全程不出本机

value.en: A 2B text model that reasons, codes and calls tools offline on a laptop — no per-call API bill, no prompt leaving the machine
value.zh: 一个 2B 文本模型在笔记本上离线推理、写代码、调工具——没有按次计费，提示词也不出本机

sources: docs/deployment/llama_cpp.md main @ 2026-10-09: released GGUF table (MiniCPM5-2B-Q4_K_M.gguf 1.56 GB); TL;DR huggingface-cli download openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-GGUF MiniCPM5-2B-Q4_K_M.gguf --local-dir ./minicpm5; OpenAI-compatible server llama-server -m MiniCPM5-2B-Q4_K_M.gguf --port 8080 -ngl 99 -c 8192 --jinja; curl http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions
